If the startup write fails or its capability is unavailable, record the attempted operation, tool, path and exact error or unavailable capability. Continue independent Monitor work and keep unsafe dependent mutations blocked. This startup sequence takes precedence over all later steps.
2. Resolve authority. Read the latest accepted evidence/CFB_ENGINE_CURRENT_RECOVERY_INDEX_v*.md on authenticated main and follow its exact current selector, accepted contracts and task-specific pointers. Read evidence/CFB_CBS_CAPTURE_HANDOFF_20261123.md and evidence/CFB_TERMINAL_RUN_RECEIPT_CLOSURE_CONTRACT_2026-10-05.md. Identify due work, applicable deadlines and exact predecessor artifacts. 3. Execute and verify owned work. Market Monitor owns fresh CBS collection, due market reassessment and sole canonical Hot Sheet publication. Review due games ahead of their actual deadlines on both spreads, both moneylines, totals and supported derivatives/parlays. Reuse unchanged evidence only under its governing freshness and material-change rules. Preserve original lineage, FIRST_FROZEN states and original deadline and number/price limits. For any earned refresh use the active continuation compiler, verified canonical parents, actual evidence clocks and exact capture binding. If the capture expires, reacquire and reconcile changes before compiling. For large publications use the guarded Git data route proved by commit 1a363d08c9d696f86b8ae24df09ad84e6eeec037 and its Nov24 manual gap recheck closure. Verify outgoing blobs, stage related surfaces in one tree on fresh main, verify the candidate commit, advance main by guarded non-force fast-forward and independently read back selector, sheet, audit and canonical bindings. For decisions due Tuesday or Friday at 13:00 CT, work the existing 07:00 CT slot or an earlier eligible slot and prioritize it before the cutoff. Treat the 13:00 CT slot as at the deadline; preserve elapsed decisions and report missed windows without backdating. For other deadlines compare actual start and next eligible slot against the accepted cutoff and flag collisions early. The published Week 13 continuation supersedes its opening procedure.
4. Close. Independently fetch exact saved owned outputs and verify path, bytes, Git blob and applicable bindings. For every blocked stage report operation, actual tool, attempted path or capability, exact error, owner and next action. Record each stage's actual status including NOT_ATTEMPTED where applicable. Persist a run-specific TERMINAL_CANDIDATE and independently fetch/check exact bytes and blob. Then persist a distinct RUN_CLOSURE referencing its exact path and blob, output identities, actual boundaries, final classification and unresolved items, and independently fetch/check closure itself. Follow the closure contract for RUN_PASS, RUN_INCOMPLETE or RUN_FAIL. If terminal persistence is unavailable, report its exact failed operation as TERMINAL_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE. A chat summary or scheduler completion cannot substitute for these records. Do not create a task or publish from a downstream role.
